name: t01v2_look_first_publish_01
command:
import json,hashlib,shutil
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools.t01v2_live_progress import read_prefix,archive
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
source='pilot_pairs_v2_look100_seq_01_j707546_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan203'
raw,extent=read_prefix(root/'data/world_pairs/v2'/(source+'_attempts.jsonl'))
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in raw.splitlines() if line.strip()]
row=next(r for r in rows if r['pair_id']=='floorplan203_00035')
assert row['status']=='passed' and row['kind']=='look_stay'
pair=(root/row['pair_file']).resolve();pair.relative_to(root/'data/world_pairs/v2')
blob=pair.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()==row['pair_sha256']
d=json.loads(blob);ref=d['review_image']
picture=(root/ref['file']).resolve();picture.relative_to(root)
image=picture.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(image).hexdigest()==ref['sha256']
out=root/'logs/review/t01v2_look_first_01';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
(out/'floorplan203_00035.png').write_bytes(image)
proof={'scope':'provisional producer-passed Look pair; source unit still running, ended-source independent checkpoint pending','source_run':source,'pair_id':row['pair_id'],'kind':row['kind'],'scene':row['scene'],'field_of_view':100,'pair_file':row['pair_file'],'pair_sha256':row['pair_sha256'],'original_review_image':ref,'published_image':{'file':str((out/'floorplan203_00035.png').relative_to(root)),'sha256':ref['sha256']},'journal_prefix':archive(raw,out,'source_journal.prefix'),'journal_extent':extent,'journal_row':row}
(out/'provisional.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
(out/'README.md').write_text('First Look review image: FloorPlan203,100degrees,Look→Stay, floorplan203_00035. This is an unchanged image from a generator-passed pair while its source unit still runs. Final source audit and independent checkpoint are pending. No completed-cohort/FOV-winner or expansion claim.\n')
print(json.dumps(proof,sort_keys=True))
